The two Finnish pronunciation fixtures are native-speaker recordings by SchwaWolf, dedicated to CC0 on Wikimedia Commons. Resampled to 16 kHz mono PCM for the tests.

- https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Fi-kissa.ogg
- https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Fi-koira.ogg
- CC0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Two short samples cannot establish overall speech-recognition accuracy, children's accuracy or performance on an Android emulator.

English-JFK.wav is a five-second excerpt of the public-domain 1961 US presidential inaugural speech, sourced from the MIT-licensed whisper.cpp repository sample: https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp/blob/v1.7.6/samples/jfk.wav . It is included only as an English recognition test fixture, not as an in-app voice.
